description: Moves a thread to trash, where mails_threads_update can move it back and where it is emptied after 30 days. With `permanent: true` the thread is deleted for good, from any folder: its messages, raw email and attachments are removed and cannot be recovered.

permanent.description: `true` deletes the thread for good instead of moving it to trash.

name: mails_threads_delete
title: Delete a thread
